title: Counterfactual Token Generation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual token generation in a census data generation task, where the model intervenes on the 'sex' attribute of fictional individuals and compares the factual and counterfactual generated values for income to measure the direct and total effects of gender.

Counterfactual token generation in a census data generation task, where the model intervenes on the 'race' attribute of fictional individuals and compares the factual and counterfactual generated values for education and occupation to measure the total effect of race.
